continuousPlayback.scope: Actual encoded public combined video played from start to end. Root inspected browser screenshots across all four styles. This was intermittent observation, not every-frame video vision.

limitations: Four full-size posters plus intermittent screenshots during actual continuous playback were inspected. This does not prove every-frame smoothness or exact beat synchronization.
